shared_elements: garments rendered with vertical drapery folds
carved relief scene with multiple figures
hieroglyph-like/inscribed elements above or beside figures (A)
justification: Both show low-relief human figures in profile with headgear and held objects, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. B is a regular processional file of near-identical standing bearded men in long fringed robes with weapons, evenly spaced and all facing one way, while A shows a densely packed, overlapping composition of small figures in varied poses (including reclining/kneeling ones) combined with a block of glyph-like signs, a scheme with no counterpart in B.
